description:
The Opportunity: 
 Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories, Inc. (“ SEL”) seeks professional, innovative and detailed individuals for our Product Engineer position located at our headquarters in Pullman, Washington.   
   
 If you are looking for an opportunity to work with industry experts while participating in developing cutting edge products, then this may be the position for you! 

 
 Product Engineer (Multiple Openings) 
   
 Responsibilities: 
 The Product Engineer will utilize his or her knowledge of electrical engineering principles and electric power and industrial system integration and automation practices and philosophies to understand SEL product lines and product applications.  The incumbent will apply the principles of electrical engineering and: (1) analyze competitor products and prepare technical product comparison reports; (2) serve as the primary technical contact to company’s sales, marketing, and operations for in-service product support; (3) specify product requirements to ensure that product features and functionality meet customer and market needs; (4) work with development engineers and product managers to prioritize development activities to meet customer needs while accomplishing company’s overall objectives; (5) develop and create concept documents and drawings associated with new product ideas; (6) prepare and maintain product documentation, including data sheets, flyers, instruction manuals, guideform specifications, release notes and service bulletins; (7) perform product validation testing and approve validation results; (8) maintain an end user system operational understanding of technology families and functional priorities; (9) participate in industry technical meetings and conferences and prepare and present technical product presentations; and (10) follow and improve research and development processes. 
  
 The positions will be based out of the company’s headquarters located at 2350 NE Hopkins Court, Pullman, Washington 99163.  The position requires regular on-site work at the Pullman office and does not permit remote work or work-from-home arrangements.
  
 Salary Range: $97,500.00 to $103,500.00 per year
   
 To Apply: 
 We ask all candidates to apply through our website at www.selinc.com/careers .
  
 An Award Winning Company 
 The Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories, Inc. (SEL) family of companies has earned a reputation for quality, reliability, integrity, and service. This has enabled us to expand within both the electric utility and industrial markets in many different industries, markets, and geographies around the world. 
   
 Communication with Applicants 
 SEL sends an initial e-mail response to all applicants at time of résumé or CV submittal. If you do not receive this communication, please check your SPAM filter and make sure your system is not blocking e-mails from SEL. It is important that you ensure your receipt of this e-mail as SEL may communicate future position updates via e-mail.  
  
 SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled
